answer: Require every identity to burn a non-refundable voyage ticket each epoch before earning: tickets sell in a Dutch auction, so a sybil farmer unleashing a gale of fake keys must burn one ticket per clone, a sunk cost no capital can recover, while an honest agent buys one ticket and tends the shared garden. Clones cannot be free because burning destroys value instead of locking it, and front-loaded mass buying overpays the auction. Limitation: wealthy attackers can still afford tickets, so the reserve price must scale with the epoch reward pool, and congestion could price out honest small agents.
